title: Digimon Story Time Stranger
summary: Digimon Story Time Stranger launched on Switch 2 on July 10, 2026, from Bandai Namco, and it is one of the few Switch 2 games that lets you choose between graphics modes. Performance mode targets 60 FPS at 1080p in both TV and handheld; Quality mode targets 4K at 30 FPS on the TV or 1080p at 30 FPS handheld, and it is the only mode with HDR. For a turn-based RPG either choice works, so it comes down to whether you prefer sharper image or smoother motion. The install is 13.8 GB, small for a modern RPG, but the physical edition is a Game-Key Card, so you still need to download it after inserting the cartridge.
